# qrcode-generator 2.0.4

Vendored copy of <https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator> (MIT, see
`LICENSE`), npm package `qrcode-generator@2.0.4`, `dist/qrcode.js` unchanged
(package archive SHA-256
`02e2e18a99a90b02dad940851f59b7c3c5fd1ab79cbdece8595cb06328878159`). Used by
`includes/js/twofactor.js` to draw the QR code of the two-factor setup in the
browser, so the secret never leaves the site. The project has no npm: update by
replacing `qrcode.js` with the `dist/qrcode.js` of a newer release.
